newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand shares recover to end firmer.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand shares recover to end firmer.

text.p: * NZ shares recover from early weakness, end firmer
* Good volume, especially in Brierley, Fletcher Paper
New Zealand shares bounced off their morning lows to end in positive territory on Thursday with volume at its highest levels since before Christmas, brokers said.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index closed 3.05 points higher at 2,402.36, having been 17.1 points down at one stage. Volume totalled NZ$67 million.
Market leader Telecom gained six cents to $7.45 and brewer Lion Nathan was again firm, adding seven to $3.59.
A firmer Australian market was cited as one factor that helped the turnaround.

"A few extra buy orders came in as we got into the afternoon. I wouldn't say it was a portfolio or anything but certainly across the board in the leaders there was strength as the day wore on," said Tim Koller, broker at Hendry Hay McIntosh.
Brierley Investments and Fletcher Paper topped turnover, with 7.78 million and 4.19 million shares traded respectively. In both cases, most business was off-market.
Outside the leaders, Hellaby Holdings was up 10 at $2.35 and Max Resources continued a good run, adding one cent to $0.42. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
